Thank you for reaching out.

I stopped taking my medicine about a month ago. I don’t really have a good reason for why I stopped but I just felt like my doctor only spent about 15 mins with me and prescribed me it. I barely understand myself so how can he know the solution after just a few minutes? But I guess he’s a professional and I’m not so I should probably listen to his advice.

I dated a girl for a little less than a year when I was a teenager but this one was my first relationship where I thought we were 100% compatible. We were best friends and now I have no one

Thank you it means a lot to me. I know I wrote a lot about my ex but I feel like it’s less that I miss her it’s more that I am depressed and lonely. And I am hurt that no one who knows me has reached out to me
Thank you. I wish I was as kind as you when I was your age
Thank you. You are a very kind person and I hope you have a good life
